title: piper cowanii
intro: Piper cowanii, commonly known as Kava or Kawakawa, is a plant native to the Pacific Islands, specifically the eastern parts of New Zealand and northern parts of Australia. The health benefits of Piper cowanii include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia. Piper cowanii has therapeutic actions such as sedation, anxiolysis, and spasmolytic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents including kavalactones (kavain, desmethoxymethyl-7-hydroxycoumarin, dihydrokavain, and dihydrokavain diacetate), which are responsible for its anxiolytic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Piper cowanii have been found to interact with the GABA receptor, leading to its therapeutic effects.
